mechanical_behaviour: High stiffness and strength potential; comparatively low room-temperature ductility in many product conditions; temperature and recrystallisation state are critical.
manufacturing: Powder metallurgy, pressing/sintering, swaging, rolling and specialised high-temperature processing.
machinability: difficult; carbide tooling, EDM and specialised processes commonly used
environment: Good high-temperature stability in inert/vacuum environments; oxidation becomes important at elevated temperature in air.
availability: specialist; common in technical/industrial supply rather than general stock

manufacturing: Powder metallurgy followed by thermomechanical processing; specialist supply chain.
environment: High-temperature oxidation requires control in air.

mechanical_behaviour: Alloying improves ductility/workability and high-temperature capability; properties remain condition dependent.
manufacturing: Specialist powder metallurgy and thermomechanical processing.
environment: Oxidation protection required for elevated-temperature air exposure.

composition: Tungsten-copper composite; composition varies by grade
mechanical_behaviour: Composite combines tungsten's stiffness/erosion resistance with copper's conductivity; thermal/electrical performance is strongly composition dependent.
manufacturing: Infiltration or powder-metallurgy routes; specialised joining and finishing.
machinability: difficult to moderate depending on grade
environment: Copper phase governs some environmental behaviour; high-temperature oxidation requires consideration.
provenance_requirement: Link to authoritative specification/standard/manufacturer or primary literature before design use.

composition: Tungsten carbide with cobalt binder; grade dependent
mechanical_behaviour: Exceptional hardness, wear resistance and compressive performance; brittle compared with metallic tungsten and sensitive to binder content and defects.
manufacturing: Powder pressing, sintering and grinding; binder composition is a primary grade variable.
machinability: poor by conventional cutting; grinding/EDM/specialised methods
environment: Cobalt binder and corrosion environment must be considered; thermal shock and edge chipping can govern performance.
availability: widely available in industrial tooling grades; specialist grades vary

composition: Tungsten with lanthanum oxide dispersion; grade dependent
mechanical_behaviour: Dispersion strengthening improves high-temperature behaviour and recrystallisation resistance in relevant grades.
environment: Oxidation remains a primary limitation for hot exposure in air.
